inputs.prompt: A light-grey faceted quadcopter with visible arm sockets, carbon-pattern arms, top-cover panels and orange motor rings. Use the reference for the four motor positions and arm directions. Orthographic top view, the nose at the top. Each of the four rotors has two equal opposite blades. Show the whole aircraft. The flight camera faces horizontally forward. From overhead its lens can be occluded; the lens glass must not face the viewer. Broaden and smooth only the four transitions from the fuselage into the arm roots. Preserve the nose, rotor centres and propellers.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, camera lens visible from above, upward-facing lens, camera on a neck or stalk, camera on a post, camera at the tail, dark module at the tail, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades
